title: Lan Ha Bay Cruise
excerpt: Let’s experience on a 5-star cruise with Vietlook, explore the beauty of Lan Ha Bay, will take visitors through famous places such as Cua Van Fishing Village, Thien Cung Cave, Dau Go Cave, Soi Sim Island, Luon Cave, Ti Top Island, Sung Sot
html:
Let’s experience on a 5-star cruise with Vietlook, explore the beauty of Lan Ha Bay, will take visitors through famous places such as Cua Van Fishing Village, Thien Cung Cave, Dau Go Cave, Soi Sim Island, Luon Cave, Ti Top Island, Sung Sot Cave… and many more interesting things.

Cua Van Fishing Village is nestled in the middle of Ha Long Bay, coming here visitors will see the undulating houses surrounded by majestic limestone ranges.

Currently, Cua Van Fishing Village is an indispensable destination in the Ha Long tour itinerary, especially visiting Cua Van Fishing Village, visitors can also experience the unique culture with fishermen in the sea.

Thien Cung Cave is one of the most beautiful caves in the bay, inside the cave there are beautiful natural rocks, a place to hide from the sun on summer days.

Dau Go Cave is located about 6 km from Bai Chay port, the cave has an ancient beauty inside the cave with beautiful naturally formed stalactites, when experiencing Ha Long cruise, visitors will admire the beautiful landscapes that nature has bestowed upon this place.

Tung Sau pearl village is a pearl farming place, coming here, visitors not only visit but also buy products made from pearls to bring back as gifts from nature.

Soi Sim Island is one of the most attractive islands in Ha Long, because of the pristine beauty of Soi Sim Island located next to Ti Top Island, Luon Cave and Sung Sot Cave…

Soi Sim Island is surrounded by primeval forests, and has many rare animals, the highlight of the island is the unique sightseeing area that attracts visitors from all over the world to come here to visit and enjoy the scenery on the island.

Luon Cave is located on Bo Hon Island, about 14 km from Tuan Chau Island, with poetic natural scenery. Luon Cave looks like a tunnel with a source of saltwater, surrounded by rocky cliffs, creating a beautiful scene.

When experiencing on a Ha Long cruise, visitors will admire the beauty of Luon Cave from the outside, here the boat is not allowed inside, visitors can experience kayaking when passing by, visitors will admire the peaceful lake exuding a unique beauty.

Ti Top Island is one of the beautiful stops in the bay, coming here visitors will encounter a clear blue beach curved in the shape of a crescent, visitors can swim, or enjoy cups of coffee overlooking the poetic sea and islands.

Sung Sot Cave is one of the most beautiful caves in the Bay, inside the cave are colorful stalactites, visitors can save beautiful pictures for themselves on the journey to discover the beauty of Ha Long by 5-star cruise.
